evidence.title: Zach Nunn said Republicans passed the largest tax cut in U.S. history. This is Mostly False.

occurrences.checkable_against: Zach Nunn social media video posted Sept. 8, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: In a Sept. 8 social media video, Nunn said, “We have cut the largest taxes in U.S. history,” when addressing volunteers door-knocking.
occurrences.speaker: Zach Nunn
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Heritage Action article cited by the Nunn campaign
occurrences.quote_span: It says Americans would face the largest tax increase in “generations” if the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act were to expire.
occurrences.speaker: Heritage Action
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Tax Foundation and PolitiFact comparisons of federal tax cuts since 1980
occurrences.quote_span: It is the third-largest tax cut when its new cuts are combined with the 2017 tax cuts that were extended by the bill.
occurrences.speaker: PolitiFact
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: PolitiFact fact-check of JD Vance's largest-tax-cut claim
occurrences.quote_span: Other Republicans, including Vice President JD Vance, have also called the legislation the largest tax cut in history, and PolitiFact rated that Mostly False.
occurrences.speaker: PolitiFact
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: PolitiFact rating methodology and fact-check record
occurrences.quote_span: This statement contains an element of truth but ignores critical facts that would give a different impression. We rate the statement Mostly False.
occurrences.speaker: PolitiFact
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Tax Foundation comparison of federal tax legislation as a share of GDP
occurrences.quote_span: Measured against the size of the economy, the tax savings in the 2025 law were smaller than earlier laws.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Tax Foundation and PolitiFact comparisons of federal tax cuts since 1980
occurrences.quote_span: The One Big Beautiful Bill is tied for the sixth-largest tax cut when looking only at the new tax cuts added by the bill.
occurrences.speaker: PolitiFact
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Tax Foundation and PolitiFact comparisons of federal tax cuts since 1980
occurrences.quote_span: But, when viewing the OBBBA as an extension of the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, the bill sits at third largest.
occurrences.speaker: PolitiFact
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Tax Foundation and PolitiFact comparisons of federal tax cuts since 1980
occurrences.quote_span: When looking exclusively at new tax cuts, the OBBBA is tied for sixth-largest since 1980.
occurrences.speaker: PolitiFact
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Carrie Houchins-Witt interview and affected taxpayers' tax returns
occurrences.quote_span: Carrie Houchins-Witt, an enrolled agent professional at Carrie Houchins-Witt Tax and Financial Services, said “a large swath of taxpayers are not seeing any tax cut,” and some people saw their taxes increase.
occurrences.speaker: Carrie Houchins-Witt
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Tax policy economists' analyses of tax cuts as a share of GDP
occurrences.quote_span: Economists say that measuring tax cuts as a percentage of gross domestic product, or GDP, is the best method.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Congressional Budget Office projections and tax cuts as a share of GDP
occurrences.quote_span: While the tax cuts are projected to be nominally large, the more effective way of understanding them is in the larger context of the economy.
occurrences.speaker: PolitiFact
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn

occurrences.checkable_against: Public Law 119-21 senior deduction provisions and clients' tax records
occurrences.quote_span: The senior deduction — $6,000 for people over 60 making less than $75,000 a year — did benefit many of her clients, she said.
occurrences.speaker: Carrie Houchins-Witt
occurrences.subject: Zach Nunn
